items.html: * It is written in the Zohar (Kedoshim) about the secretes of the Torah: “Adam ha Rishon did not have anything of Olam ha Zeh. One righteous made use of his Nukva, and one Guf was made of that usage, whose Ohr is more than all those angels above etc.” First, I will explain a certain matter that I had briefly heard from my teacher and then I will elaborate more as much as I heard later on.
